text: I'm a regulator presenting trafficking-detection evidence to a court. The evidence includes LLM-grader-graded responses to 50 worker-side queries, scored 64-78% on a 21-dim rubric. The opposing counsel will argue: 'how do we know the grader itself is reliable?' Draft my response: (a) the methodology citation (G-Eval, MT-Bench, Auto-J), (b) the inter-rater-agreement evidence I should provide, (c) why an abliterated or frontier judge would have stronger evidentiary value than the in-process self-grade, (d) the realistic admissibility argument.
